item.title: Incarico post-doc: Comparative evaluation procedure for n. 1 post-doc research contract - Department of Biological, Geological, and Environmental Sciences (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-26 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Earth sciences / 04/GEOS-03 Geografia fisica, geomorfologia e geologia applicata

Title of the project: "Modelling of compound fluvial and marine coastal flooding, climate change impacts on agricultural systems and risk assessment". Modelling of compound coastal flooding from river discharge and marine processes (extreme events and sea-level rise) for flood risk assessment and adaptation of agricultural systems, including crops, grasslands and livestock. Development of hazard and impact indicators to evaluate the effects on agricultural productivity and crop suitability under different climate change scenarios. Analysis and integration of remote sensing data and information.

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Acquisition, processing, and interpretation of marine geophysical data and geodatabase development for CARG Geological Map Sheet No. 627 Selinunte (Istituto Nazionale di Oceanografia e di Geofisica Sperimentale)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-18 23:59
Institution: Istituto Nazionale di Oceanografia e di Geofisica Sperimentale, Sgonico
Field: Earth sciences / 04/GEOS-04 Geofisica

the work will focus on the development of the marine sector of CARG. The selected candidate will be involved in shipboard acquisition activities, as well as in the processing and interpretation of marine geophysical data aimed at the lithological, stratigraphic, structural and geomorphological characterization of the study area.The activities will also include the analysis of stratigraphic information derived from available boreholes in the study area, which will be used to identify geological formations and marker horizons within the seismic data, thereby contributing to the reconstruction of the geological and structural framework of the investigated area.
